Attestra AI-Powered CRA Platform for SMEs | CRA-AI Project

# Ship Secure Products. Faster. 

CRA conformity without the complexity. Attestra’s AI platform takes you from first assessment to final attestation, saving time, cutting costs, and keeping your products on the market. Built through the EU Co-funded project CRA-AI.

- Readiness Assessment 

## What We Are Building 

The EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) comes into force in December 2027, requiring all manufacturers of connected products to meet mandatory cybersecurity requirements before selling in Europe. Attestra is an AI-powered platform designed to guide product companies—particularly SMEs without dedicated cyber teams—through the full CRA compliance journey. From understanding what applies to you, through risk assessment and security testing, to producing the documentation needed for conformity. Alongside the platform, Attestra Academy provides training courses to help your team build the knowledge and skills needed to meet CRA obligations confidently.

Vulnerability & Incident Reporting Meet your September 2026 obligations—manage vulnerability disclosure, triage, and reporting from day one.

Risk Assessment Import your SBOM, build a digital twin of your product, conduct threat-led risk assessments, and document security-by-design decisions.

Product Testing Create test suites, link them to security objectives, collect evidence, and produce test reports.

Documentation & Attestation Generate the technical documentation required for conformity and prepare your Declaration of Conformity.

Product Maintenance Manage the ongoing lifecycle—track fixes, update documentation, and loop back through assessments as products evolve.

Attestra Academy Training courses to help your team understand and apply CRA requirements with confidence.

 

- ###### Project duration 

24 months, starting January 1, 2025

###### Project budget (maximum grant amount)

€2,873,164.00 /€2,043,272.00

##### Cyber Cert Labs

Attestra is an AI-powered platform built to guide product companies through the full CRA conformity journey. Designed for SMEs—particularly those without dedicated cybersecurity teams—it combines intelligent automation with deep regulatory expertise to turn complex requirements into clear, manageable actions.

##### Refracted Security

Refracted Security will develop their existing vulnerability management platform and connect to the core platform via APIs to provide security testing capabilities such as secure coding analysis and pen testing

##### Cyber Cert Labs 

Attestra Academy sits alongside the platform, offering structured training courses that help product and technical teams build practical knowledge of CRA requirements and the skills to apply them with confidence.

##### NRD Cyber Security

NRD Cyber Security are a cyber security company with two products that are in scope for the CRA. They will act as a pilot test case for the software platform.

##### DNSC

The National Cyber Security Directorate (DNSC) will be responsible for the dissemination work package which includes webinars, events and a market scan to see the maturity of SMEs.

##### Red Alert Labs

Red Alert Labs will participate in the test customer pilot using NRDCS products as the test case. The outcomes will inform what artifacts the software needs to produce to prepare SMEs for a conformity assessment.
